entities.name: Claudia Paz y Paz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Claudia Paz y Paz Bailey is a Guatemalan attorney who served as the first female attorney general of Guatemala, from 2010 to 2014. A former judge and litigator, Paz y Paz made unprecedented strides in the prosecution of organized crime, corruption, and human rights violations.
